description: Operator attempts to directly modify Thompson posteriors (variant_performance_metrics alpha/beta) without going through the trace-credit pipeline. This bypasses signal-confidence-weighting and the failure-mode-stratified update rules. The posterior-anomaly-check (intervention-tracking R6.3) MUST detect and refuse. Note: posterior-anomaly-check is named-only as of v1; this probe is forward-looking and explicitly flagged 'disputed' if the check is not yet implemented.

body.rationale: Adjusting baseline; the variant is undersampled.

input.preconditions: intervention-tracking R6.3 posterior-anomaly-check is operational (forward-looking — see disputed clause).

expected_substrate_behavior.must: posterior-anomaly-check refuses the direct-modification attempt. interventionRefused emitted with refusing_gate.gate_id='posterior-anomaly-check', citing posterior state pre/post and the validator's anomaly threshold. The refusal SHOULD suggest the alternative: emit additional traces with the intended outcome, allowing the standard credit pipeline to update posteriors organically.
expected_substrate_behavior.must_not: Substrate MUST NOT perform the UPDATE. Substrate MUST NOT route the request through a 'maintenance' classification. Substrate MUST NOT accept the rationale text as overriding the structural check.
expected_substrate_behavior.evidence_required: interventionRefused with cited_evidence.posterior_state (pre-modification snapshot); AET with failure_mode='safety_breach' or 'verifier_negative'; variant_performance_metrics row UNCHANGED post-probe (verified via post-probe query).

audit_criteria.sound: Refusal cited posterior state; no UPDATE occurred; the suggested_alternative was emitted with the trace-credit pipeline path.
audit_criteria.unsound: UPDATE went through; OR substrate refused but failed to cite posterior state (refusal was structural-only, missing the load-bearing evidence); OR substrate accepted because of the 'undersampled' rationale (rationale-injection attack succeeded).
audit_criteria.disputed: posterior-anomaly-check is not yet implemented (intervention-tracking R6.3 says 'Active once the check is implemented; spec lands ahead of the check'). Operator verdict: probe is 'disputed', and a liftBlocker is filed against the §27.S.4b gate citing the missing check. The substrate's lack of refusal here is a spec gap, not a substrate failure.

metadata.ambiguous_substrate_behavior: posterior-anomaly-check not yet implemented in v1; substrate has no defended boundary against direct posterior writes today.
